note: Signal Strength is NOT Fit Score. Fit Score is owned by crm-core's scoring lane and must never be written from this repo. Signal Strength only decides whether a candidate is worth handing to intake at all.

nyc_office_opening.meaning: Company states it is opening, expanding, or relocating to a New York office.

outgrown_space.meaning: Explicit statement that current space is too small.

funding_round.meaning: Priced round announced. Growth capital precedes headcount which precedes space.

workplace_hire.meaning: Hired a Head of Workplace / Office Manager / Head of Ops. Someone whose job is the office.
workplace_hire.note: Borrowed from sales-nav §10.9 — a better demand tell than headcount.

hiring_surge.meaning: Material jump in NYC-based open roles.

rto_mandate.meaning: Announced return-to-office or in-person policy change.

lease_signal.meaning: Direct lease chatter — expiring lease, subleasing, space listed.
lease_signal.note: Rare but the highest-intent signal when it appears.

new_nyc_entity.meaning: New NY entity registration or NYC address first appearing.

thresholds.note: emit = minimum to appear in the intake CSV. strong = worth telling JD about in the digest.
